resources.string:
Smart Expense Manager accesses and stores SMS message data on your device to identify bank and payment transaction messages, import recent transaction history, and detect new transactions even when the app is closed.

The app reads the SMS sender, message text, and date, then extracts financial details such as the amount, merchant, bank, and transaction type for expense tracking and budgeting. Unrelated messages are not added to your expense records. Full SMS message text is not sold, used for advertising, or sent to our service.

If you choose to use online AI Insights, parsed financial details—including date, amount, merchant, category, transaction type, and bank—are securely sent to our service to generate those insights. You can continue using manual expense entry without SMS access.

Tap “Allow SMS access” to consent and continue.

Allow Smart Expense Manager to send you notifications when new transactions are detected. You can quickly categorize expenses directly from the notification.\n\nThis helps you stay on top of your spending in real-time.
Great! Smart Expense Manager can now automatically track your bank transactions from SMS messages. You\'ll see them appear in the Messages tab.
SMS access was not granted. You can continue using manual expense entry, or grant access later in Settings > Apps > Smart Expense Manager > Permissions.
You won\'t receive push notifications for new transactions. You can enable them later in Settings > Apps > Smart Expense Manager > Permissions.

Smart Expense Manager accesses recent and incoming SMS after you grant permission. SMS sender, message text, and date are processed on your device to identify financial transactions. Recognized transaction messages and extracted details are stored in the app's local database; unrelated messages are not added to your expense records.

The app uses your Google account name and email for sign-in. When you choose online AI Insights, parsed financial details—including date, amount, merchant, category, transaction type, and bank—are transmitted over HTTPS to our service to generate insights. Full SMS message text is not transmitted. Data is not sold or used for advertising.

Local transaction records remain until you use Clear All Data or uninstall the app. You can deny or revoke SMS access and continue with manual expense entry. For privacy or deletion questions concerning online services, contact support@smartexpenseai.com.

Dashboard shows total spending, transaction count, top categories, top merchants, and spending trends for the selected period.
Try later: change “This Month” to compare a different period, then scroll to inspect the graphs.
Messages contains imported and manually added expenses. Filter by UPI, card, bank, or wallet and choose which records count toward totals.
Try later: long-press a merchant to rename or recategorize it. Expand a group and swipe a transaction to delete or restore it.
Categories group related transactions and show how much each area contributes to your spending.
Try later: open a category to move merchants, create a custom category, or configure a category budget.
AI Insights provides category charts, forecasts, pattern alerts, budget suggestions, and possible savings opportunities.
Try later: adjust the date and category filters or swipe between available charts. Online insights use parsed financial details, not full SMS text.
Profile contains budget goals, notifications, export, recurring expenses, privacy information, and account controls.
You can replay this tour anytime by choosing “How Smart Expense works” on this screen.
